- Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Passion for sustainable mobility and a customer-first mindset.
- Basic PC skills (Email, MS Office).
- Good knowledge of English (German is a plus).
- Willingness to work in a team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- High-impact role with responsibility for leading and mentoring a talented team of mechanics.

- Be part of a fast-growing startup in the sustainable e-mobility sector, with a mission-driven focus.

jobs.description:

- Develop high-speed digital electronics, including multi-gigabit serial links and high-speed memory-to-FPGA interfaces
- Verify circuit performance through simulation, including worst-case analysis, derating, and signal integrity analysis
- Supervise PCB layout activities for multilayer and rigid-flex high-reliability PCBs
- Test and validate your circuits in the laboratory as well as under extreme conditions during qualification and acceptance testing
- Collaborate closely with other engineering disciplines, including mechanical design, radiation engineering, EEE engineering, manufacturing, and FPGA/IP core design
Your Qualifications

- Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering or a comparable discipline
- At least 5 years of professional experience in the design of digital electronics hardware, including FPGAs, microcontrollers, and high-speed digital interface standards such as JESD204, DDR memory, PCI, or Wizard Link, ideally in the space industry
- Experience in electronics design in accordance with applicable ECSS standards
- Knowledge of spacecraft communication interface standards such as SpaceWire, MIL-STD-1553, and SpaceFibre
- Experience with at least one programming language suitable for controlling automated test setups, such as Python or C/C++
- Experience with ECAD design and simulation tools, e.g. Siemens PADS Professional, Xpedition, Spice, or HyperLynx
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Your Tasks

- Manage / Support the preparation of proposals; inter alia (depending on the specific proposal, the candidate will have to either take full responsibility or only support the different tasks):
- Lead the proposal team towards the delivery of a proposals, on quality, time and cost
- Ensure that the proposal properly answer to the customer requirements; both formal requirements (conditions of tender, technical, programmatic, financial requirements, etc) and unofficial customer needs (technical, programmatic, financial, contractual, industrial, political, etc)
- Ensure that the proposal passes all the required reviews (content and cost) and that expectations of all internal stakeholders are reflected

- Support the improvement of proposal processes, proposal quality and thus likelihood of proposal success

- Completed studies (Diploma or Master) in aerospace engineering or equivalent qualification (i.e. mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, physics)

jobs.occupation: Early Years Educator / Pädagogische Fachkraft Kindergarten englischsprachig (m/w/d) (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (m/w/d)
Full-time or part-time | Munich Alt-Bogenhausen

Phorms Campus Munich is a bilingual German-English education campus offering educational programmes from Crèche and Kindergarten through Primary School to Secondary School. Our well-located and lovingly maintained city campus in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, close to the English Garden, is home to an international school community where children, families and staff feel welcome, supported and valued.

In our bilingual Kindergarten and Crèche, we encourage children to try out new things, respect themselves and others, develop empathy and curiosity, and grow in confidence and independence. In this way, we build a strong foundation for their future education.

For our Kindergarten and Crèche in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, we are looking for a motivated and qualified Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (all genders) in full-time or part-time.

Your Responsibilities

• Supporting and fostering children in their individual development according to our Early Childhood curriculum
• Creating a warm, safe and stimulating learning environment for children in Crèche and Kindergarten
• Observing, assessing and documenting children’s learning journeys and developmental progress
• Planning and implementing age-appropriate educational activities
• Working closely with parents in a professional and trust-based parent-teacher partnership
• Bringing your own interests, strengths and creative ideas into the daily life of the Kindergarten
• Collaborating respectfully and supportively with colleagues in a bilingual and international team

Your Profile

• Completed qualification or degree in Early Childhood Education, Early Years Education, Childcare, Pedagogy, Social Pedagogy or a comparable field
• Ideally recognised as a qualified early years professional in Bavaria, or willingness to have your qualification checked for recognition
• Professional experience in early childhood education is an advantage
• Excellent English skills at native or near-native level, as you will work as an English-speaking reference person within our bilingual concept
• German language skills are not mandatory at the start
• Willingness and motivation to learn German and develop your language skills over time
• Enjoyment of working with children in Crèche and Kindergarten age groups
• Interest in working in a bilingual and international educational environment
• Team spirit, reliability, responsibility, empathy and motivation
• Valid work permit for Germany, EU citizenship or a residence title allowing employment in Germany

Our Benefits

• Attractive and competitive remuneration package                                                                                                   • Annual special payment of up to €1,500 gross, depending on working hours                                                    • Additional employer benefits, for example public transport pass or Edenred City Card
• Free healthy lunch
• Subsidised EGYM Wellpass membership
• Comprehensive company pension scheme
• Relocation support for work-related moves
• Corporate Benefits Portal
• 34 days of annual leave
• Regular working hours and long-term shift planning for better work-life balance
• Dedicated preparation and planning time, both individually and within the team
• Regular staff meetings during working hours
• Wide range of professional development and training opportunities
• Support in learning German through language courses and everyday practice in an international environment
• Attractively furnished group rooms, children’s kitchen, well-equipped gymnastics room, extensive library and generous outdoor area
• Modern digital equipment, including iPads and smart displays in preschool
• Bilingual teaching teams with up to three qualified pedagogical team members per group
• Support from additional teaching and administrative staff, including music and sports teachers
• Age-oriented groups with dedicated preschool classes
• A warm, international team on a beautiful campus close to the English Garden

Please note

For this position, a relevant early years qualification is required. Applications from international professionals are welcome, provided that a valid work permit for Germany is in place or can be obtained. For qualifications obtained outside Germany, recognition as a qualified early years professional in Bavaria should already be available or be possible to assess.

German language skills are not required at the beginning. However, we are looking for candidates who are motivated to learn German and willing to develop their language skills while working in our international environment.

Would you like to support children in a bilingual, international Kindergarten and bring your English language skills into meaningful early years education? Then we look forward to receiving your application via our website.

Further information can be found at: https://www.phorms.de/en/career/munich/ (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/munich/) .
If you have any questions, please contact Katharina: careers@phorms.de (https://mailto:careers@phorms.de)

jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM), TUM Center for QuantumEngineering (ZQE)
jobs.description:
The research group for the Topology of Correlated Systems at the TUM Center for Quantum Engineering (ZQE) and the Department of Physics is looking for a postdoctoral researcher (f/m/d) to join the BMFTR-funded collaborative project “GarliQ - Green Advanced Refrigerants: Light-element oxides & intermetallics for Quantum cooling” at the earliest possible date. The position is initially limited to 3 years, full-time.

GarliQ is a collaborative project between TUM and kiutra GmbH, funded under the BMFTR call “Enabling Technologies for Resilient R&D Supply Chains in Quantum Technologies”. The project aims to develop new materials with magnetocaloric properties for use as cooling media in adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration (ADR) systems in the millikelvin temperature range - key components of the cryogenic infrastructure for quantum technologies.

Independent synthesis of magnetocaloric material systems (oxide and intermetallic compounds) via solid-state synthesis and melt crystal growth
Structural characterization of the synthesized materials, including by X-ray diffraction
Investigation of magnetic and thermodynamic low-temperature properties using standard and dilution refrigerator cryostats; as applicable, experiments at neutron and synchrotron sources
Determination of magnetocaloric parameters (isothermal entropy change, adiabatic temperature change)
Scale-up of promising synthesis routes for integration into ADR cooling systems, in close coordination with the industrial project partner kiutra GmbH
Supervision of PhD students, master's students, and student assistants within the project
Writing scientific publications for peer-reviewed journals
Presentation of results at national and international conferences

Completed doctorate in physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related field
Solid experience in the synthesis of inorganic solids
Knowledge of structural characterization (powder X-ray diffraction, Laue diffraction, microscopy, …)
Experience with magnetic and thermodynamic measurements (magnetometry, susceptibility, heat capacity, …) at low and ultra-low temperatures
Experience operating crystal growth facilities and/or cryostats
Demonstrated publication record in solid-state physics or materials science
Independent, structured way of working and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is an advantage
Experience supervising students is an advantage
We offer the opportunity to contribute to an internationally visible research topic at the interface of solid-state physics and quantum technologies - in an excellently equipped low-temperature laboratory at the TUM Department of Physics and in close collaboration with an innovative industry partner.
TUM offers a working environment with flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, and open communication, as well as a comprehensive, free range of professional and personal development opportunities.
Remuneration is based on qualifications according to TV-L. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women in its workforce; applications from women are therefore explicitly encouraged.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join Siemens Energy’s Transformers factory network as a Operational Excellence Professional (f/m/d) in Germany and help drive greater efficiency, productivity, and shorter lead times. You will lead continuous improvement and cost-reduction initiatives that support profitable revenue growth across multiple manufacturing sites. Working closely with factory teams, you will share best practices, standardize operating methods, and strengthen Lean ways of working. You will use performance data to identify opportunities, solve operational challenges, and support informed decision-making. Your work will help build a more agile, transparent, and efficient manufacturing organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead process improvement and cost-reduction projects across the Transformers factory network to improve output and cost-effectiveness
* Define project scope, goals, deliverables, and schedules, and collaborate with factory leadership and project sponsors to ensure successful execution
* Facilitate cross-functional workshops and best practice exchanges between manufacturing sites to support operational excellence
* Develop, implement, and maintain standard operating methods, while training and coaching colleagues in Lean methodologies and continuous improvement practices
* Manage operational performance data, monitor KPIs and OKRs, and analyze production and logistics processes to identify inefficiencies and implement data-driven improvements

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a closely related field
* Many years of professional experience in project execution, production, or logistics within a manufacturing environment
* Lean Training or a Lean Certification and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Strong expertise in Lean methodologies, Six Sigma tools, value stream mapping, process optimization, root cause analysis, and problem solving
* Experience in project planning and execution, workshop facilitation, stakeholder and change management, performance monitoring, and cost analysis
* Very good communication in English and German

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
